title: Another complaint desk cannot look up a tracking number to take its appeal
build: d209b79 + current ComplaintIntake DEV index-DQZ/current phase source; contract a4772c79e2249316e1a9
actual: Fresh synthetic complaint4 CMP-2026-00004 was received through the Admissions UI and conveyed a synthetic outcome. demo.admissions GET /complaints/4 is200 Resolved can_appeal:true. At the Reception desk, GET /complaints?mine=false&limit=1000 is200 but returns only complaints1,2,3 received by that user; GET /complaints/4 is403 FORBIDDEN. The bundle's GET /complaints has no tracking-number search/filter and no alternative lookup. Therefore a complainant bringing Admissions' tracking number to Reception cannot open the record through the available directory, even within the appeal window. No frontend or appeal POST defect is alleged.
